# castai_role (Data Source)

Looks up a single RBAC role in a Cast AI organization by its exact, case-sensitive name. Role names are unique per organization, so the name identifies the role; the data source errors if no role with the given name exists. Useful for resolving role IDs (Owner, Member, Viewer) without maintaining a hardcoded UUID map.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve the Viewer role ID by name instead of hardcoding the role UUID.
# Role names are unique per organization, so the name identifies the role.
data "castai_role" "viewer" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "Viewer"
}

resource "castai_role_bindings" "viewer_test" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "Role binding viewer"

  role_id = data.castai_role.viewer.id

  scopes {
    kind        = "cluster"
    resource_id = var.cluster_id
  }

  subjects {
    subject {
      kind    = "user"
      user_id = var.user_id
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive name of the role to look up.
- `organization_id` (String) Cast AI organization ID.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Server-side role type filter. One of: ALL (default), DEFAULT, ENTERPRISE.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a default (built-in) role.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether this role is deprecated.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `level` (Number) Priority level of the role (higher is more important).
- `permissions` (List of Object) Permissions granted by the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `effect` (String)
- `endpoints` (List of String)
- `groups` (List of String)
